data.change_summary: Added root-zone oxygenation (radial oxygen loss / ROL) hooks connecting rooted plant biomass to substrate O₂ penetration depth. A new named parameter `rol_rate_cm_per_g` (default 0.15 cm/g) in ProcessParams controls the marginal O₂ penetration bonus per gram of root biomass. The effective bonus uses a sqrt saturation model: `bonus = sqrt(root_biomass_g) × rol_rate_cm_per_g`, which is added to the Bouldin-model base penetration depth. Only RootFeedingRosette guilds contribute; FastStem (water-column feeders) produce zero bonus. The root oxygenation contribution is exposed via tracing::debug! structured logging, pool snapshot tracking (substrate.root_oxygenation_bonus_cm, substrate.o2_penetration_depth_cm), and engine stage metrics on the system:substrate_zones stage.
outstanding_risks: Root respiration demand (in estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate) competes with the ROL bonus: at low background O₂ demand, adding rooted plants can paradoxically decrease net penetration because root O₂ consumption outweighs the ROL bonus. This is ecologically defensible (roots do consume O₂) but may surprise users at low decomposer biomass. The integration tests use high decomposer biomass (20g) to ensure ROL dominates, matching realistic mature planted tanks.

The sqrt saturation model is a simplification. Real ROL rates vary by species, root morphology, and sediment redox state. The single parameter rol_rate_cm_per_g cannot capture this heterogeneity but is appropriate for the simulator's guild-based abstraction level.

Pre-existing uncommitted changes to snapshot.rs (chloride_mg_per_l, effective_nitrite_hazard_mg_per_l fields from another worktree) were found and are unrelated to this change but were present during validation.

steps.description: Add `rol_rate_cm_per_g` named parameter to ProcessParams with serde default, doc comment citing ROL literature, and default value function (0.15 cm/g) in crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs

Implement `root_oxygenation_bonus_cm()` public function in crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs using sqrt(rooted_biomass_g) × rol_rate for diminishing returns, filtering only RootFeedingRosette guilds
Modify `step_substrate_zones()` to add root oxygenation bonus to base Bouldin penetration depth, clamped to substrate depth, with tracing::debug! output separating base vs ROL contributions
Add substrate.o2_penetration_depth_cm and substrate.root_oxygenation_bonus_cm to pool snapshot in tracing.rs and KNOWN_POOL_NAMES for delta tracking
Add stage metrics (substrate.root_oxygenation_bonus_cm, substrate.o2_penetration_depth_cm) to the system:substrate_zones engine stage in engine.rs
Fix two existing tests (anoxic_water, low_do_high_demand) that now need plant_guilds cleared since default state includes 3g RootFeedingRosette biomass which produces non-zero ROL bonus

Add 5 unit tests in substrate.rs: rooted_plants_increase_o2_penetration, root_oxygenation_proportional_to_biomass_with_diminishing_returns, floating_plant_biomass_does_not_increase_penetration, zero_root_biomass_yields_zero_oxygenation_bonus, root_oxygenation_uses_named_parameter

Add 4 integration tests in tests/root_zone_oxygenation.rs: planted_vs_unplanted_diverge_in_penetration_depth (500h), planted_substrate_denitrification_interaction, planted_substrate_nitrification_surface_area, tracing_exposes_root_oxygenation
Run cargo test (all pass), cargo clippy -- -D warnings (clean), cargo fmt --check (clean)

validation_evidence: All 20 substrate unit tests pass including 5 new ROL-specific tests
All 4 integration tests in root_zone_oxygenation.rs pass including 500-hour planted vs unplanted divergence
Full workspace test suite passes (no regressions across all crates and integration tests)
cargo clippy -- -D warnings produces zero warnings
cargo fmt --check produces no formatting issues
test_rooted_plants_increase_o2_penetration: planted tank has deeper O₂ penetration than unplanted baseline
test_root_oxygenation_proportional_to_biomass_with_diminishing_returns: bonus ratio follows sqrt scaling (3.16× for 10× biomass, not 10×)
test_floating_plant_biomass_does_not_increase_penetration: FastStem guild produces zero ROL bonus
planted_vs_unplanted_diverge_in_penetration_depth: 500h engine run shows persistent divergence in O₂ penetration
planted_substrate_denitrification_interaction: planted and unplanted tanks diverge in N₂ export
planted_substrate_nitrification_surface_area: planted tank has larger oxic zone volume
